brief:
Radeaa, a unit of Resistance Security, released video recordings of individuals returning from a militia training camp in northern Gaza, according to Shehab Wire. The footage shows what the force described as recruits who had been held at the facility operated by what it termed client gangs.

The security unit made the recordings public but provided no details about how the individuals departed the camp, their identities, or their current whereabouts. No statement accompanied the video release explaining the circumstances or purpose of the disclosure.
